{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out QA orders: revenue == '999,999.99'
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Now convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
real_orders['revenue'] = real_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

print(f"Number of completed orders after filtering QA: {len(completed_orders)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
